phase_a.analizar_el_disco_blu_ray_montad: : analyze the mounted Blu-ray disc in 4 steps — identify MPLS/tracks with mkvmerge -J, extract the chapters from the MPLS, enrich with MediaInfo (bitrate, format_commercial, HDR10, channels) and — if there's Dolby Vision with an EL — run dovi_tool to detect the profile and the CM version. The result feeds the Phase B rules.

phase_a.ts_parse_0_paquetes_para_los: ⚠️ TS parse: 0 packets for the {target_pids} PIDs of the MPLS in {sample_desc} ({p3}s). Likely causes: a long intro with no dialogue, or very scattered subs. The counts stay at 0 — phase_b tells forced from full by relative ratio.
phase_a.ts_parse_b_pkt_0_paquetes: ⚠️ TS parse ({packet_size}B/pkt): 0 packets in the PGS range (0x1200-0x12FF) after {sample_desc} ({p3}s). Top non-AV PIDs detected: {top_str}. If the subtitles are there but in another range, AV_PID_RANGES or the PGS range has to be widened.

phase_d.extrayendo_todas_las_pistas_del_: 📋 Extracting every track from the source into an intermediate MKV in /mnt/tmp with mkvmerge (direct read, no re-encoding). The selection and the metadata are applied afterwards.
phase_d.intermedio_con_todas_las_pistas_: : an intermediate file with every track from the source, no re-encoding. Ready for Phase C.
phase_d.mkvmerge_aborto_al_ensamblar_la_: mkvmerge aborted while assembling the playlist's file list (a known bug with multi-segment / multi-angle UHD discs).
phase_d.mkvmerge_no_genero_el_mkv_interm: mkvmerge didn't generate the intermediate MKV in {out_path}
phase_d.mkvmerge_sin_actividad_min_abort: mkvmerge idle for >{p1} min — aborted (probably hung, the queue isn't blocked)
phase_d.no_se_encontraron_ficheros_mpls_: No MPLS files found under {share_path}. Check that the mounted disc contains BDMV/PLAYLIST/.
phase_e.aplicando_los_metadatos_al_mkv_i: 📋 Applying the metadata to the intermediate MKV with mkvpropedit: it edits only the container headers (track names, default/forced flags and chapters) without copying the data again. The MKV is then moved to the final directory with an atomic rename.
phase_e.generando_el_mkv_final_con_un: 📋 Building the final MKV with a single mkvmerge: track selection, reordering, names, flags and chapters in one pass. It saves a full copy compared with the route that goes through an intermediate.
phase_e.mkv_en_mnt_output_con_metadatos: : MKV in /mnt/output with the metadata applied without copying the content again (only the headers edited).
phase_e.mkv_en_mnt_output_con_pistas: : MKV in /mnt/output with the right tracks, names, flags and chapters. Direct route — a single copy.
phase_e.mkvmerge_no_genero_el_mkv_final: mkvmerge did not produce the final MKV at {output_path}
